questions.question_hindi: नीचे दिए गए अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) पर विचार करें। अभिकथन: नियमित अवकाश के पात्र औद्योगिक और कार्य-प्रभारित कर्मचारी LTC के पात्र हैं। कारण: CCS (LTC) नियम प्रत्येक कर्मचारी पर, उसके नियमित अवकाश के अधिकार की परवाह किए बिना, समान रूप से लागू होते हैं।
options_hindi: A और R दोनों सत्य हैं तथा R, A की सही व्याख्या है
A और R दोनों सत्य हैं, लेकिन R, A की सही व्याख्या नहीं है
A सत्य है, लेकिन R असत्य है
A असत्य है, लेकिन R सत्य है
questions.question_english:
Assertion (A): Industrial and work-charged staff who are entitled to regular leave are eligible for LTC.
Reason (R): The CCS (LTC) Rules apply universally to all employees, irrespective of their leave entitlements.
Select the correct relationship between A and R.
options_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
questions.explanation_english: A is true but R is false Industrial and work-charged staff who are entitled to regular leave are eligible for Leave Travel Concession under specific administrative provisions. However, the Central Civil Services Leave Travel Concession Rules do not apply universally to all employees regardless of leave entitlements. Exclusions exist for daily-rated workers, staff paid from contingencies, and those lacking regular leave rights.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) है: A सत्य है, लेकिन R असत्य है। नियमित अवकाश के पात्र औद्योगिक और कार्य-प्रभारित कर्मचारी विशेष प्रशासनिक प्रावधानों के अंतर्गत पात्र हो सकते हैं। इससे यह निष्कर्ष नहीं निकलता कि CCS (LTC) नियम सभी कर्मचारियों पर बिना शर्त लागू होते हैं।

II. अलग-अलग समूहों में यात्रा की जा सकती है, लेकिन अंतिम समूह की आगे की यात्रा पहले समूह के रवाना होने के छह महीने के भीतर शुरू होनी चाहिए।
III. प्रत्येक समूह की वापसी यात्रा उसकी आगे की यात्रा से छह महीने के भीतर पूरी होनी चाहिए।
कौन-से कथन सही हैं?
options_hindi: केवल I और II
केवल I और III

questions.question_english:
Consider these statements about family members travelling in separate batches on LTC:
I. All family members must travel in a single group.
II. Different groups are allowed if the last group's outward journey begins within six months of the first group's departure.
III. Each group's return journey must finish within six months of its outward departure.
Which statement(s) are correct?
options_english: I and II only
I and III only
II and III only
I, II and III
questions.explanation_english: II and III only When family members travel in separate batches under Leave Travel Concession, the outward journey of the last batch must commence within six months of the first batch’s departure. Furthermore, return journeys for all batches must be completed within six months from their respective outward departure dates to qualify for reimbursement.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) है: केवल II और III। परिवार के सभी सदस्यों का एक साथ यात्रा करना अनिवार्य नहीं है। अलग समूह स्वीकार्य हैं, यदि अंतिम समूह की आउटवर्ड यात्रा पहले समूह के प्रस्थान के छह महीने के भीतर शुरू हो और हर समूह की वापसी समय-सीमा में पूरी हो।

questions.question_english: A government servant wants to include their spouse, who is also a government servant, in an LTC claim. The spouse has already used their own LTC entitlement in the same block. Can the spouse be included again?

Forward the claim directly to the Principal Accounts Office for granting special payment
Reject or restrict to train fare as private booking violates rules
Deduct 10% of the claim amount as an administrative penalty and pass the rest
questions.explanation_english: Reject or restrict to train fare as private booking violates rules Government rules mandate that air tickets for Leave Travel Concession must be purchased directly from airlines or authorized travel agencies. questions.question_english: A government servant undertakes an LTC journey in a private car. Which statement correctly describes whether the journey is admissible for reimbursement?

Actual fuel and toll costs are fully reimbursable against original receipts
It is permitted only when a medical certificate establishes inability to travel by public transport
questions.explanation_english: Not permissible; reimbursement is restricted to entitled public transport fare Under standard Leave Travel Concession rules, undertaking journeys by personal car or private vehicle is not permissible for financial reimbursement. When an employee travels in a personal car between stations connected by public transport, the reimbursement is strictly restricted to the entitled class fare of public transport or train by the shortest direct route.

questions.explanation_english: Economy fares published by Air India used as reimbursement ceiling In Leave Travel Concession claims, LTC-80 refers to the specific economy airfare scheme published by Air India that serves as the official ceiling limit for reimbursing air journeys. Reimbursement for air travel is capped at the LTC-80 rate or actual fare paid, whichever is lower.
